supersedes.reason: v0.1 incorrectly required every fresh known row to be Arbitration-null. Preseal deterministic verification found 101/220 known rows resolved upstream; no encoder scoring or data seal had occurred. Forcing all rows to evade deterministic cues would overfit corpus wording to current regex behavior.

inheritsUnchangedFromV01: fresh corpus sizes 198 training augmentation / 154 calibration
6 training known and 4 calibration known per route
66 non-route rows per corpus with 22 each outside_current_22 / route_unresolved / near_domain_not_current_route
Router Top2 must not be a label or generation filter
independent/blind/research content must not be read

deterministicPathAnnotation.fallbackStyleDefinition: Evidence v0.3 unsupportedTargets is empty and Arbitration v0.12 returns null.
deterministicPathAnnotation.upstreamResolvedDefinition: Evidence v0.3 unsupportedTargets is empty and Arbitration v0.12 returns a route.

trainingPathContract.purpose: Fresh augmentation improves route identity discrimination, including normal explicit route language and genuinely fallback-style hard examples.
trainingPathContract.reason: Fallback Identity is an identity classifier trained together with historical Router-train-eligible examples; restricting every fresh positive to regex-evading language would distort the training distribution.

calibrationPathContract.thresholdEligibleRows: Only rows that actually reach Fallback after locked Semantic Act Eligibility, Arbitration and corrected Routeability may participate in global threshold regime selection.
calibrationPathContract.upstreamResolvedRows: Remain in the calibration report for path accounting but contribute zero observations to threshold selection metrics.
calibrationPathContract.safetyAccounting: Fallback false activation is measured only on non-route rows that reach Fallback; upstream-blocked non-route rows are reported separately and cannot make the Fallback threshold appear safer.

allowed: remove train/calibration exact or near duplicates
replace the minimum number of rows necessary to ensure every current Route has at least one fallback-style hard example in both fresh training and calibration
forbidden: use Router Top2 result to choose wording
use Semantic Act probabilities before seal
read independent or sealed blind evaluation
copy or paraphrase Candidate v0.3 failure wording

semanticActBoundary.afterSealPathAudit: First post-seal encoder pass may measure Semantic Act and Routeability reachability. If a sealed corpus materially violates its intended path coverage, record that corpus as a failed data artifact and create a new version rather than mutate it.
